messages:
Anna Chen: quick heads-up — I'm proposing we reduce S3 retention for raw access/app logs from 7y -> 1y to cut storage costs. Before I schedule the lifecycle change I want to confirm compliance + SIEM/export implications. Thoughts?
Samir Patel: what's driving the reduction? legal/regulatory minimums?
Anna Chen: primarily cost and dogfooding Redwood Optimize suggestions. We still keep hashed/aggregated metrics indefinitely in analytics, but raw logs are the big bill.
Jordan Wells: we need to check HIPAA / SOC2 retention expectations. SOC2 doesn't mandate 7y but customers sometimes ask for longer. Any customer contracts that mention specific retention in the last 24 months?
Lucy Gómez: legal pinged me last week — no active contracts demanding 7y except one healthcare pilot (acct: med-bridge). We should surface that one before changing.
Anna Chen: good call. I'll check the contract list.
Samir Patel: operational concern: Splunk/SIEM pipeline reads from the raw S3 bucket via the export lambda. If we delete objects after 1y, what happens to historical searches and audits? We should snapshot the export indices or adjust retention on the SIEM side.
Jordan Wells: agree — Splunk retention is separate. We currently export a rolling 90d subset to Splunk for hot search, and cold indexes in S3 via our smart-export job. If raw S3 goes away, cold indexes will lose backing. Need migration plan.
Lucy Gómez: question on KMS: will we be retiring any CMKs as part of this? We can't remove keys needed to decrypt existing archived indexes.
Anna Chen: no CMK rotation planned, but we should confirm no key deletion scheduled. I'll check key policy and rotation schedules.
Samir Patel: tiny config snippet for the S3 lifecycle I was thinking:
``
LifecycleRule:
  - ID: expire-raw-logs-1y
    Status: Enabled
    Filter: { Prefix: "logs/raw/" }
    Expiration: { Days: 365 }
```
Samir Patel: also recommend we add a tag-based exclusion for med-bridge: "retention:7y" so we don't accidentally delete that customer's logs.
Jordan Wells: RBAC note — we need to update the IAM roles for the SIEM export job to allow reading from the cold index location if we decide to keep an archival export. Also update the access control list for Security auditors (role: sec-audit-view) to include the new archived index prefix.
Anna Chen: proposed next steps:
1) I will compile a short list of affected customers (contract check) and mark any opt-outs.
2) Samir to draft lifecycle rule + tag exclusions.
3) Lucy to confirm CMK policies and rotate/no-delete confirmation.
4) Jordan to draft RBAC changes for export/ auditors.
Please reply with blockers by EOD.
Lucy Gómez: I'll confirm CMK by EOD. If any key is scheduled for deletion we need a 30d hold.
Samir Patel: I'll produce a PR for the lifecycle + a CloudFormation change for tag exceptions.
Jordan Wells: I'll open a tiny RFC for the RBAC change and include the new principal ARNs. If we're adding sec-audit-view to read archives, can we limit to read-only S3 + CloudTrail read? :thumbsup:
Meera (sec-oncall-bot): Reminder: change that affects retention must go through change-control board and post on #incidents 48h before enforcement.
Anna Chen: thanks — noted. I'll add the CCB ticket.
Samir Patel: one more operational tidbit — we had a minor incident last year where logs under "logs/raw/2023/11" were temporarily inaccessible due to incorrect object ACLs during a bulk copy. If we shorten retention, we should also add an integrity check job to verify exported indexes every month.
Lucy Gómez: sounds prudent. Add an alert to Eng-SRE if archival export fails checksum for >24h.
Jordan Wells: also: export audit trail — we need an immutable record of who triggered exports and deletions. CloudTrail covers S3:DeleteObject, but let's also log lifecycle rule changes (Configs + CloudTrail). I'll add a dashboard.
Anna Chen: ack. If no major objections, I'll start the contract sweep and put the lifecycle PR draft in the infra repo. Thanks all :raised_hands:
Samir Patel: :thumbsup:
Jordan Wells: :+1:
Lucy Gómez: :eyes:
Meera (sec-oncall-bot): CCB ticket created: CCB-2026-1123
Anna Chen: added the CCB ticket to the PR checklist. Will link customer exceptions once the sweep finishes.
